about_the_game:
As the Blight grows with each passing day, the worlds wither in turn. The drifting planes that still light the sky fade like embers, and the powers that live to see them covet dominion of the few centuries that remain. A young man from a distant plane is taken from his home, and fights to find peace, before all ends in silence.

Embark on an adventure through a mysterious galaxy, blending intense FPS action with the strategy of RPGs.

An endlessly deep campaign, densely packed with dozens of hours of replayability.

A GALACTIC JOURNEY

Discover new worlds in 3 main books, with 21 enormous chapters to be explored and plundered, each handcrafted and fully unique with their own aesthetic, lore, and enemies.

Ancient temples, shadowy space piers, towering cities; all dense with loot, secrets, and deadly encounters.

RAW COMBAT

Face off against 45 enemy types and 12 brutal bosses in combat combining bullet hell, hack-and-slash, and FPS.

Each encounter is a dangerous test of skill and resourcefulness; when enemies are fighting at full capacity, you won't be pulling punches.

DEATH LURKS

'Essence' from slain foes turns into a 'shard', which will revive you should your party fall. But die without any shards, and you lose everything.

Surviving to the end of a book will take all your wits and skill.

BUILD YOUR PARTY

Swash-buckle and parry with dual cutlasses, rocket jump with a mecha arm cannon, battle as a knight in explosive armour, or just throw big rocks at people.

Use 6 characters, 100+ unique weapons across 16 types, passive-granting armours, and items that all make meaningful differences to your playstyle.

Random loot means no two runs are the same, and equipping new loot gives you essence, so be ready to adapt!

UNCOVER THE PAST

Immerse yourself in a story inspired by classic pulp fantasy, equal parts mature and unhinged, telling a personal tale atop a brewing intrigue and an ancient tragedy.

Rich and dense prose packs a sci-fi RPG epic into a blitzing FPS campaign.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains blood, cursing, partial nudity, and sexual themes.
